de: Second Battle of Panipat: Fighting begins between the forces of Hem Chandra Vikramaditya, the Hindu king at Delhi and the forces of the Muslim emperor Akbar.

de: The Catholicon, written in 1464 by Jehan Lagadeuc in Tréguier, is published; this is the first Breton dictionary as well as the first French dictionary.

te: Lý Anh Tông is enthroned as emperor of Vietnam at the age of two, beginning a 37-year reign.
dz: 黎安通被封为越南皇帝 二岁开始统治37年.
